facts.claim: Cold-climate air source heat pump rebate for homes heating with electricity, oil, propane or wood
facts.eligibility: Homeowner; detached, semi, row/townhome or mobile home on permanent foundation; not a new build occupied 6 months or less; connected to Ontario grid
facts.dates: No end date listed on official site as of 2026-09-26

facts.claim: Ground source heat pump, electricity/oil/propane/wood heat
Enbridge Gas customers heating mainly with a gas furnace or boiler
facts.amount: Air source $500/ton up to $2,000; ground source $3,000
facts.notes: Rentals get the same lower amounts regardless of fuel

facts.eligibility: Enbridge gas-heated or electrically heated/cooled home; no previous thermostat rebate from Enbridge, Save on Energy or HRS; Cornwall Electric customers excluded
facts.dates: Upload receipt within 60 days of purchase
facts.notes: Eligible brands: ecobee, Google Nest, Honeywell Home, Copeland Sensi, Mysa, Sinope (specific models)

facts.program: Home Renovation Savings (HRS) - solar and battery
facts.claim: Solar PV and battery (battery only with new solar)
facts.amount: Solar $1,000/kW up to $5,000; battery $300/kWh up to $5,000; each max 50% of cost; up to $10,000 combined
facts.eligibility: Cannot also take a net-metering agreement with the LDC
facts.notes: Solar/battery program page returned HTTP 500 during check; amounts confirmed on homerenovationsavings.ca home page (up to $10,000) and search snippet of the solar page

facts.program: Home Renovation Savings (HRS) - no-assessment attic insulation
facts.notes: Detail page returned HTTP 500; per-R-value tiers on site pages ($1,250/$1,000/$800) left as published

facts.amount: Attic to R-50: $1,500 / $1,200 / $900 by starting R-value; cathedral/flat roof $780; exterior wall $3,600 / $2,100 / $1,200; basement wall $1,500 / $900; slab $500; header $300; crawlspace wall $1,200 / $600; crawlspace ceiling $1,200; exposed floor $300; total insulation up to $7,700
facts.eligibility: Pre- and post-work home energy assessment

facts.amount: Windows/doors $100 per rough opening; heat pump water heater $500; air sealing $200 ($250 if 10% above target); assessment rebate $600; $500 bonus for 3+ upgrades
Heat pump dryer $200; induction cooktop/range $150; washer $75; fridge $50; freezer $50; dishwasher $25
facts.eligibility: Ontario grid customer (not Cornwall Electric); replacing an existing electric appliance; new (not used) eligible model

facts.claim: No HRS rebate for a new gas furnace
facts.notes: Program lists heat pumps, not furnaces

facts.amount: $75 virtual prepaid Mastercard on enrollment; $20 per year for continued participation
facts.eligibility: Ontario electricity customers (any LDC) with central AC or a heat pump controlled by an eligible Wi-Fi thermostat; not high-rise units with building HVAC
facts.dates: Annual $20 tied to enrolling before Sept 30 of prior year
facts.notes: Run by IESO/Save on Energy, not by individual utilities. No free thermostat.

facts.amount: Free: comprehensive support can include insulation, draft proofing, appliances, programmable/smart thermostats, and cold-climate heat pumps for oil-heated homes; or free energy saving kits
facts.eligibility: Comprehensive: income up to $48,220 (1 person) to $96,439 (4 people); kits: $71,437 to $142,873; or on OW/ODSP/OESP, on-reserve, or social housing; owners or renters on the utility account
facts.notes: The only real 'free thermostat' path in Ontario, including Ottawa. Phone 1-844-770-3148

facts.claim: City loan repaid on property tax bill
facts.amount: Up to $125,000 (capped at 10% of CVA), terms up to 20 years
facts.notes: Current interest rates not re-verified; pages tell readers to confirm

facts.claim: City loan repaid on property tax bill
facts.amount: Up to $125,000 or 10% of CVA, whichever is less; 20 years; 4.33% fixed; 0% for households under income thresholds
facts.eligibility: Ottawa property owners; excludes gas upgrades

facts.claim: Loan only for GrandBridge Energy customers; coaching region-wide
facts.amount: Up to $40,000 at 2.5% fixed, 10 or 15 years, repaid on GrandBridge bill
facts.eligibility: Loan: GrandBridge customers in Cambridge and North Dumfries, 25%+ energy reduction. Free Energy Coach: homeowners anywhere in Waterloo Region
facts.notes: Kitchener and Waterloo are Enova Power, so no loan there
